test_title: PYST 17: SSC JE CE - Reasoning (Held on: 23 Mar 2021 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Read the following information and answer the questions.

Seven cups labelled 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7 are arranged on a shelf, such that:

 
• Cup 3 is placed third to the left of cup 7.
 
• Neither cup 3 nor cup 7 are placed at the extreme ends of the shelf.
 
• Only one cup is placed between cup 3 and cup 5.
 
• Cup 4 is not placed immediate next to either cup 3 or cup 7.
 
• Two cups are placed between cup 5 and cup 1.
 
• Cup 2 is placed immediately next to cup 4.

How many cups are placed between cup 1 and cup 7?
solution:
Arranging the cups 1,2,3,4,5,6 and 7 according to given information :

1. Cup 3 is placed third to the left of cup 7.

2. Neither cup 3 nor cup 7 are placed at the extreme ends of the shelf.

(Two cases are arising here)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1527970418307898699f284f65a9802333bc6cb2d4e9017e9f77b367e7620f9d.png] 

3. Cup 4 is not placed immediate next to either cup 3 or cup 7.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/453d89fff414bc51a1b9e49dd80d45a4819dfc1bab504b1d1e732d8f63a11a73.png] 

4. Only one cup is placed between cup 3 and cup 5.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7f3acc710c727914d5a16f4113d4605ce23d1fb705dd2ae916e623c33f13bbd3.png] 

5. Two cups are placed between cup 5 and cup 1.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9387f8711606a2b94f899108a23dde03aafcf03f117a074b4b87273b0360fd68.png] 

6. Cup 2 is placed immediately next to cup 4 (Only case 2 is satisfying the condition).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a7bba72eb8e5fee59c6daaf00abacd52e2ec63fc0080a0e38557c62fdfb98cb6.png] 

So, case 1 is discarded.

The final arrangement is :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7e3fe1cbc580397ec20ba2c75c5a6fb15c754e36a71088bf614163b236206455.png] 

**Cups 3,6 and 5 are between cups 1 and 7.**

Hence, the correct answer is **"3".**
